cautions: Owner-supplied research; citations extracted from PDF hyperlinks, not independently archive-verified. Claims remain pending. No Shockbase used. Original PDFs, scans and full conversations are not published.
Exact regional identifiers are independent search records, not proof of distinct hardware. Release events, reissues and retail packages are not additional individual watch identifiers.
GWG-1000 lengths 56.7 and historical 59.5 mm conflict by source. Neither replaces the other without reconciliation.
Frogman special-color weights 115 g / 141 g are inherited nominal values, not independently verified variant weights. Titanium ~85–86 g is reported; no unverified titanium factory weight is assigned.
GWF-D1000B-1LTD is a collector package. 7W-SP-MMJ is a collaborator catalog code, not a verified conventional Casio SKU. GWF-1000TBS may be a transcription/alternate designation; unresolved.
Reported edition quantities retain their evidence class. Global inventories are not certified exhaustive. Shared module functions never establish case dimensions, band, crystal or weight.
